correctness.rationale: Exact exhaustive enumeration of all 792 five-arc subsets on labeled four loopless patches under the ordered degree constraints returns exactly five strongly connected realizations, characteristic polynomials t^4−t−1 (two), t^4−t²−1 (two), and t(t³−2) (one), and the first and last of these are ordered by Perron roots as stated. I independently enumerated all two- and three-vertex loopless digraphs and showed each ordered bidegree sequence determines a unique characteristic polynomial; a strongly connected four-vertex graph with four edges is necessarily a directed 4-cycle. The graph J=−mu I+lambda A^T follows by linearizing the specified deterministic occupancy ODE; 5/4 lies strictly between root of t^4−t−1 and cuberoot 2. Thus n=4 and five edges are sharp and the stability separation is local, not stochastic indefinite survival.
residual_risks: Exhaustive lower bound is for loopless unweighted simple directed graphs with strong connectivity and patchwise matched bidegrees, not all weighted graphs.

originality.rationale: The principal ecological prior source Shtilerman–Stone 2015 uses adjacency Perron roots, directed patch dispersal, degree correlation and reciprocal-link symmetry, but its accessible scientific abstract does not announce a full 4-patch five-route joint-degree spectral classification. Our independently exhaustive five-arc directed classification is an exact first counterexample to sufficiency of degree profiles and reciprocity, distinct from general PF threshold theory. The full primary manuscript was unavailable via tried OA/publisher access and Oxford returned vpn_disconnected; explicitly preserve this residual historical-priority risk rather than failing O by access alone.

value.rationale: The first network order and arc budget at which local in/out degrees plus nonreciprocity fail to determine the Perron invasion threshold is a natural structural boundary in directed dispersal models. Full sharp five-graph census and opposite local stability under equal demographic rates give a meaningful minimal counterexample; this is not a numerical comparison of arbitrary graph slices.
residual_risks: The claim concerns linear local stability in deterministic occupancy dynamics, not stochastic persistence thresholds or heterogeneous weighted dispersal.

limitations: Full Shtilerman–Stone paper inaccessible; exact-priority risk remains despite mathematically valid local result.
